FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
Defense scans, predicts, and guards crossings, and forced hits rank roadside, still, same-way, and soft targets [A01].
Why it matters: group defense; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F01, sec09-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
Stops open with signaled pullovers, dead engines and audio, seated riders, and shown hands [A01].
Why it matters: group stops; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A02
Cabins light at night and drop tint by day, obey orders, and declare weapons before reaching [A02].
Why it matters: group stops; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A02
Officers credential up, explain stops, and announce-then-reach for papers [A02].
Why it matters: group stops; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A02
Outcomes warn, ticket, or arrest, signatures concede nothing, refusals jail, and courts hear contests [A02].
Why it matters: group stops; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A03
Crash duty stops, calls, hazards, aids, clears, swaps, and sketches [A03].
Why it matters: group crash-duty; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A03
Officers paper DUI, death, injury, and tows, while drivers self-report the rest inside 10 days [A03].
Why it matters: group reports; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A03
Unattended hits hunt owners, then leave name, contact, and plate notes with officer notice [A03].
Why it matters: group reports; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A03
Leaving a crash scene involving death is a first-degree felony carrying at least four years in prison, leaving one involving serious bodily injury is a second-degree felony, leaving one involving injury is a third-degree felony, and all three carry at least a three-year driver license revocation [A03].
Why it matters: group hit-run; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A04
Aid calls anyway, parks far and lit, freezes spines, and keeps helmets on [A04] [A03].
Why it matters: group first-aid; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A04
Shock calms flat with raised legs, blankets, dry mouths, and open airways [A04].
Why it matters: group shock; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A04
Rear defense gaps four seconds, lamps clean, mirrors live, signals early, and stops gradual [A04].
Why it matters: group rear-end; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F13 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A04
Breakdowns clear wheels, show 200 feet both ways, flash, unload roadside, and call [A04].
Why it matters: group breakdown; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F14 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A04
Plain brakes pump while anti-locks stomp, hold, and steer, easing only locking fronts [A04].
Why it matters: group braking; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F15 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec09-R15 | anchor: A05
Fires exit and call, fight small blazes dry, and flee fumes and blasts [A05].
Why it matters: group fire; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F16 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec09-R16 | anchor: A05
Stuck pedals lift, neutralize, press softly, and steer safe, sparing the key until last [A05].
Why it matters: group pedal; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F17 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec09-R17 | anchor: A05
Overcorrection rolls panic steerers, so exits calm firm and gas-free [A05].
Why it matters: group control; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F18 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec09-R18 | anchor: A05
Dark crossings run four-way by arrival with left-yields-right ties [A05].
Why it matters: group outage; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F19 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec09-R19 | anchor: A05
Dropped wheels coast straight and rejoin slowly, while skids steer into the slide gas-free [A05].
Why it matters: group control; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F20, sec09-F21 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec09-R20 | anchor: A05
Track stalls empty all at once against 20-second train minimums [A05].
Why it matters: group rail; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F22 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec09-R21 | anchor: A06
Train comers sprint 45 degrees toward steel, then call, and blue signs list railroad rescue [A06].
Why it matters: group rail; difficulty high; prereq sec09-R20; confusables sec09-F23 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec09-R22 | anchor: A06
Sinking cars float under a minute, so riders window out before doors flood with tools handy [A06].
Why it matters: group submersion; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F24 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec09-R23 | anchor: A06
Blowouts coast brakeless into soft stops while wet brakes dry under slow low-gear pedals [A06].
Why it matters: group tires-brakes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F25, sec09-F27 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0088]

FACT_ID: sec09-R24 | anchor: A06
Wrong-way comers take horns, flashes, hard brakes, and roadside steers [A06].
Why it matters: group wrong-way; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F26 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0088]
